hr_zones.title: Hr Zones
hr_zones.description: empty if no threshold / no HR

pace_zones.title: Pace Zones
pace_zones.description: runs with a threshold speed only

threshold.description: the record valid at the activity date

rest_hr_current.title: Rest Hr Current
rest_hr_current.description: bpm, the value used today (override or median)

run_bike_split.title: Run Bike Split
run_bike_split.description: share of weekly load for running (0–1)

preferred_days.title: Preferred Days
preferred_days.description: role per weekday mon…sun (METRICS §10.3), defaults filled in; empty without athlete

preferred_days.title: Preferred Days
preferred_days.description: weekday (mon…sun) → role [+ sport]; missing days take the default, {} resets all

clear_rest_hr_override.title: Clear Rest Hr Override
clear_rest_hr_override.description: true → remove the manual rest HR (back to the 28-day Garmin median)

AthleteIn.title: AthleteIn
AthleteIn.description: PUT /settings/athlete body; null fields are left unchanged.

median.title: Median
median.description: median of the valid values of D-28 … D-1; null with < 7 values

mad.title: Mad
mad.description: raw median absolute deviation (no scaling), same window

BaselineDTO.title: BaselineDTO
BaselineDTO.description: Trailing 28-day baseline of one wellness field (METRICS §8, day itself excluded).

partial_rho.title: Partial Rho
partial_rho.description: Spearman on OLS residuals after TSB, ATL[D-1], load[D-1]

q_contrast.title: Q Contrast
q_contrast.description: mean outcome top quartile − bottom quartile (outcome unit)

uncertain.title: Uncertain
uncertain.description: the headline CI contains 0 (or there is none)

headline_rho.title: Headline Rho
headline_rho.description: partial ρ if present, else raw ρ (sort key)

sentence.title: Sentence
sentence.description: one plain-Slovak sentence describing the finding

CorrelationDTO.title: CorrelationDTO
CorrelationDTO.description: One (sport, predictor, outcome) finding (METRICS §9). Null statistics are null.

findings.title: Findings
findings.description: status ok, sorted by |headline ρ| descending

caveat.title: Caveat
caveat.description: fixed Slovak caveat text (METRICS §9.5); always show it

CorrelationsDTO.title: CorrelationsDTO
CorrelationsDTO.description: GET /wellness/correlations – findings sorted by |headline ρ| plus the pairs without enough data.

hr_bin.title: Hr Bin
hr_bin.description: lower edge of the 5 bpm bin

gap_speed.title: Gap Speed
gap_speed.description: median GAP speed in the bin, m/s

ref_hr.title: Ref Hr
ref_hr.description: 0.80 · LTHR valid at the window end, bpm

rule.title: Rule
rule.description: §10.4 rule that decided (1–4); null when an existing plan was kept

acwr.title: Acwr
acwr.description: ACWR[D−1], the last complete day (rule input)

created.title: Created
created.description: true: decided just now; false: an existing plan was returned

DailyDecisionDTO.title: DailyDecisionDTO
DailyDecisionDTO.description: GET /plan/today – the day's planned workout with the inputs the decision used (METRICS §10.4).

this_week.title: This Week
this_week.description: per sport + all (zeros if nothing yet)

last4_avg.title: Last4 Avg
last4_avg.description: per sport + all: mean of the 4 previous ISO weeks

sync_stale.title: Sync Stale
sync_stale.description: last successful sync older than 36 h (PLAN phase 8 health)

activities_without_threshold.title: Activities Without Threshold
activities_without_threshold.description: activities with no threshold record valid at their date

activities_without_load.title: Activities Without Load
activities_without_load.description: activities whose load_primary is null (no LTHR, no HR, …)

hrtss_rtss_divergent.title: Hrtss Rtss Divergent
hrtss_rtss_divergent.description: runs where hrTSS and rTSS differ by > 40 % of the smaller value (threshold check)

active.title: Active
active.description: false stores the goal without using it (all others off)

GoalIn.title: GoalIn
GoalIn.description: PUT /plan/goal body: the race the season is built towards. Replaces the active goal.

diff_pct.title: Diff Pct
diff_pct.description: |hrTSS − rTSS| / min(hrTSS, rTSS) · 100 (relative to the smaller)

r.title: R
r.description: Pearson correlation coefficient, null if n < 3

LoadSanityDTO.title: LoadSanityDTO
LoadSanityDTO.description: METRICS §2.5: Pearson r between load_primary and Garmin training load.

missed.title: Missed
missed.description: planned/pushed and its date is before today

provisional.title: Provisional
provisional.description: decided before the day's sync; the sync's nightly step decides it again

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: one-line Slovak reason of the decision

actual_load.title: Actual Load
actual_load.description: load of the completed activity (its primary load)

PlannedWorkoutDTO.title: PlannedWorkoutDTO
PlannedWorkoutDTO.description: A planned workout (METRICS §10.5); `sport = "rest"` is a rest day with no steps.

warming_up.title: Warming Up
warming_up.description: within the first 90 days of the series (§4)

PreferredDayDTO.title: PreferredDayDTO
PreferredDayDTO.description: A weekday of the template: role and an optional explicit sport (METRICS §10.3).

change.title: Change
change.description: relative (speed) or bpm (lthr) difference; null without current

garmin_lthr.title: Garmin Lthr
garmin_lthr.description: Garmin's own lactate-threshold HR, bpm (if available)

payload.title: Payload
payload.description: the Garmin workout JSON (dry run only)

score.title: Score
score.description: component score 0–100; null when the input is missing

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: renormalized weight (the used ones sum to 1); null if missing

value.title: Value
value.description: raw input: bpm (rhr), sleep score points or seconds (sleep, see unit), Body Battery points, TSB (form)

baseline.title: Baseline
baseline.description: 28-day median of the input (context only; the RHR score and the sleep fallback use it)

available.title: Available
available.description: false when the day has no wellness component (no score)

components.title: Components
components.description: always the four components, in table order

markdown.title: Markdown
markdown.description: the report body (Markdown, without the file header)

SeasonDTO.title: SeasonDTO
SeasonDTO.description: GET /plan/season – this week and the projected weeks after it (up to the race week + 1).

days_to_race.title: Days To Race
days_to_race.description: days from this Monday to the race; null without a goal

ctl_start.title: Ctl Start
ctl_start.description: CTL of the day before the Monday (projected for future weeks)

is_race_week.title: Is Race Week
is_race_week.description: the week containing the goal's race date

SeasonWeekDTO.title: SeasonWeekDTO
SeasonWeekDTO.description: One ISO week of the season plan (METRICS §10.1–§10.2). Loads are TSS-equivalent points.

points.title: Points
points.description: date ascending; EF/decoupling only for steady-state runs

caveat.title: Caveat
caveat.description: e.g. bike EF: terrain/wind dependent – trend only (§5.4)

SeriesDTO.title: SeriesDTO
SeriesDTO.description: GET /progress/ef (EF / decoupling / pace_at_ref_hr_day per activity + trend).

value.title: Value
value.description: metric value of that activity (EF: m/min per bpm; pace metric: m/s)

thresholds.title: Thresholds
thresholds.description: full history, sport then valid_from ascending

hr_zones.title: Hr Zones
hr_zones.description: per sport, absolute bpm bounds of today's zones

pace_zones.title: Pace Zones
pace_zones.description: run pace zones in m/s for today's threshold

points.title: Points
points.description: number of points after LTTB downsampling

series.title: Series
series.description: requested: hr (bpm), speed / gap_speed (m/s), alt (m), grade, cadence, distance (m)

activities.title: Activities
activities.description: number of activities on the day

done_load.title: Done Load
done_load.description: Σ load_total of the week's days

WeekPlanDTO.title: WeekPlanDTO
WeekPlanDTO.description: GET /plan/week – the ISO week containing the requested date: targets, planned vs done per day.

date_from.title: Date From
date_from.description: requested start, else the first returned day

date_to.title: Date To
date_to.description: requested end, else the last returned day

WellnessDTO.title: WellnessDTO
WellnessDTO.description: GET /wellness/daily – wellness rows (only days that have one), date ascending.

baselines.description: baselines valid for this day (computed over the full history)

sleep_debt_7_s.title: Sleep Debt 7 S
sleep_debt_7_s.description: 7-night sleep debt, seconds (METRICS §9); negative = surplus; null with < 5 valid nights

WellnessDayDTO.title: WellnessDayDTO
WellnessDayDTO.description: One wellness row: the night that ends on the morning of `date`, RHR / Body Battery of `date`.

duration_s.title: Duration S
duration_s.description: seconds of one round (not multiplied by `repeat`)

zone.title: Zone
zone.description: 1–5: HR zone, pace zone, or the effort zone of an open step

repeat.title: Repeat
repeat.description: repeat count when the step is inside a repeat, else null

group.title: Group
group.description: index of the repeat block (0, 1, …), else null

WorkoutStepDTO.title: WorkoutStepDTO
WorkoutStepDTO.description: One plain step of a workout, flattened for display; steps of a repeat share `group` and `repeat`.

lower.title: Lower
lower.description: bpm or m/s bound of the threshold used; null = open
